reason.title: Reason
reason.default: Asked to talk to a person

CallbackIn.title: CallbackIn
CallbackIn.description: 'Talk to a person' from the widget (PRD F1.7, F3.4). Needs contact consent first.

text_version.title: Text Version
text_version.description: Version of the consent text shown

ConversationEventIn.title: ConversationEventIn
ConversationEventIn.description: Implicit signals (PRD F8.3) and the counts behind the 3.5 metric definitions.

DelegatesIn.title: DelegatesIn
DelegatesIn.description:
PRD 8.3: who gets an overdue proposal before the College Admin. Keys are departments, or
'default' for college-wide proposals; values name a person.

destination.title: Destination
destination.description: Guardian's e-mail, or WhatsApp number with country code

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the WhatsApp code message

HandoffIn.title: HandoffIn
HandoffIn.description: Called by Module B (PRD F3.4) when a question needs a person.

score.title: Score
score.description: From Module B's scoring rules (PRD F5.4)

LeadIn.title: LeadIn
LeadIn.description: Created by Module B (conversational capture) or the widget's lead card, only after consent.

LocalText.title: LocalText
LocalText.description:
The college's own widget texts in one more language. Anything left out is not shown in
that language (rather than shown in English), except the name and greeting, which fall back
to the widget's own wording.

as_correction.title: As Correction
as_correction.description: Offer this reply as a correction (PRD F3.6)

send_email.title: Send Email
send_email.description: Also e-mail the reply to the applicant, or a minor's guardian (PRD F3.6)

send_whatsapp.title: Send Whatsapp
send_whatsapp.description: Also send the reply on WhatsApp through Module B: the applicant's number, or a minor's guardian who verified on WhatsApp (PRD F3.6). Outside the 24-hour window only the college's approved template can be sent.

send_sms.title: Send Sms
send_sms.description: Also send the reply by SMS to the applicant's mobile number (adults only; a minor's guardian agreed to e-mail or WhatsApp). Long replies are shortened to three SMS.

SecondReviewIn.title: SecondReviewIn
SecondReviewIn.description: PRD 8.3: a second approver's verdict on a sampled, already approved proposal.

greeting.title: Greeting
greeting.default: Hello! Ask me anything about admissions.

topics.title: Topics
topics.description: Quick topic chips, like the admissions menu on the college site

translations.title: Translations
translations.description: The texts above in Hindi and Kannada, for visitors who choose them

TenantConfig.title: TenantConfig
TenantConfig.description: Per-college settings from the Tenant Pack that Module C uses (PRD F10.1).

temporary_password.title: Temporary Password
temporary_password.description: Shown once; the person changes it after first sign-in
